Default values and benchmarks 

The Commission has published the corrected default values. An Excel file is made available for information purposes only, while the legally binding values are set out in Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2621. 

Following publication of the corrected default values in Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1740, a consolidated version of Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2621 will be available soon
